description: Land Settlement Dept. - Pubbarapotha, Balangoda D/S Division, Ratnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620007 (23/0972)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, locations, and ownership details) by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement. The content focuses on land ownership adjudication and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title matters.
